item.title: Army detonates nearly five tons of lead-based explosives in Iowa
item.description: The controlled detonation of more than 60 barrels — roughly five tons — of unstable lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa is complete.

item.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia leaves U.S. voluntarily for Spain
item.description: Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran immigrant who became a symbol of Trump's mass deportation campaign, voluntarily left the country on Tuesday after nearly two years of legal battles.

item.title: These deer walk 300 miles a year. The race is on to save their migration
item.description: Mule deer in Wyoming make some of the longest land migrations in the lower 48 states. They're trying to adapt to a changing climate, but growing development could stand in their way.

item.title: The Army says there's no reason to panic over controlled ammunition detonation in Iowa
item.description: The U.S. Army says it has taken precautions and there's no reason to panic about its' plan to detonate unusable bomb making material at its ammunition plant in Iowa, scheduled for Wednesday morning.

item.title: How tariffs, fuel and fertilizer costs are squeezing the U.S.'s biggest apple region
item.description: Washington's $9 billion industry grows more than 70% of the nation's fresh apples. Farmers are being pressed by high costs, tariffs and a strong dollar that diminishes foreign purchasing power.
